article.headline: Johnson scores 27 as Tarleton State downs Mississippi Valley State 88-64
article.description: — Dior Johnson had 27 points in Tarleton State's 88-64 victory against Mississippi Valley State on Tuesday.
article.linkText: Johnson scores 27 as Tarleton State downs Mississippi Valley State 88-64

categories.description: Tarleton State Texans @ Mississippi Valley State Delta Devils

event.description: Tarleton State Texans @ Mississippi Valley State Delta Devils

keywords: Tarleton State Texans @ Mississippi Valley State Delta Devils
article.story: ITTA BENA, Miss. -- — Dior Johnson had 27 points in Tarleton State's 88-64 victory against Mississippi Valley State on Tuesday. Johnson added five rebounds and four steals for the Texans (8-4). Cam McDowell scored 26 points while shooting 7 for 12 from the floor and 10 of 10 from the free-throw line. Kaia Isaac had nine points and shot 3 for 9, including 3 for 6 from beyond the arc. Michael James led the way for the Delta Devils (1-10) with 27 points, four assists and four steals. Patrick Punch added 15 points for Mississippi Valley State. The loss is the ninth straight for the Delta Devils. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
